task.description: Hard gate on TEST-DESIGNER's coverage (commit 28808b73). Independently verify every acceptance criterion has a runnable test, no skipped coverage, isolated self-sufficient fixtures. Per WF-03_issue_resolving.md's fail-then-pass section: this is a fix to EXISTING behavior, not a new module, so you must not accept the reported fail-then-pass proof on trust -- independently re-run AT LEAST the :assertion_run_missing test (ISS-0732's own headline symptom) against pre-fix code yourself (a throwaway git worktree of main, same technique TEST-DESIGNER used) and confirm it fails with the reported fail-mode, then confirm it passes on this branch. result.summary: Independently re-derived, not trusted. (1) Read all 5 new tests directly in test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs (lines 404-582 on this branch): :assertion_run_missing (409, body["detail"] =~ "no assertion run has been recorded", review stays :approved, target definition absent, PromotionAssertionRun count == 0), :assertion_run_digest_mismatch (409, detail =~ "does not match the plan_digest being applied", review stays :approved, definition absent), :assertion_run_failed (409, detail =~ "recorded failing assertions", review stays :approved, definition absent), :assertion_run_in_progress (409, detail =~ "has not finished yet", review stays :approved, definition absent), and the teardown_failed-still-accepted non-regression case (200, status applied, definition really moves). Every one asserts a concrete HTTP status plus a specific error-detail substring plus an actual DB-state check on the rejection paths (nothing written) -- none are loose/placeholder assertions. (2) Diff-checked test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs against main myself (`git diff main...HEAD -- test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs`, 258 lines): every changed line is a `+` addition (new describe blocks, two new fixture helpers, and 3 call sites where insert_passing_assertion_run!/3 was ADDED before an apply_promotion call that was already expected to succeed -- required by the new gate, not a weakened assertion). Zero `-` lines against any existing assertion. No existing test's assertion was weakened. (3) Independently re-ran the fail-then-pass proof myself for :assertion_run_missing (ISS-0732's headline symptom) rather than trusting TEST-DESIGNER's report: confirmed mix.lock is byte-identical between main and HEAD (`git diff main...HEAD -- mix.lock` empty) and that 4efff094 (the actual gate commit) plus 13a5dc3e are branch-only via `git log main..HEAD`. Created a throwaway worktree `git worktree add ../letflow-wt-tdv-iss0732 main`, symlinked deps/_build from this checkout (safe reuse given the identical lockfile, not a shortcut past real compilation), ran `MIX_ENV=test mix compile` clean (273 files, no errors), copied the CURRENT post-edit test file into the worktree, and ran `MIX_ENV=test mix test test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs:405` against pre-fix main: **0/1 passed, 1 failed** -- `Assertion with == failed / code: assert resp.status == 409 / left: 200 / right: 409` at line 423, i.e. apply succeeded with 200 where pre-fix code has no rehearsal gate at all -- exactly the reported fail-mode and exactly ISS-0732's own described defect shape. Removed the deps/_build symlinks, ran `git worktree remove ../letflow-wt-tdv-iss0732 --force`, and verified removal via both `git worktree list` (no longer listed) and `ls c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\` (directory absent). Then ran the identical test on THIS branch (post-fix, no worktree, read-only, no mutation to my own checkout): `MIX_ENV=test mix test test/letflow/routers/req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs:405` -> **1 passed, 36 excluded**. Confirmed `git status --porcelain` on my own checkout shows only the pre-existing unrelated untracked `web/tests/e2e/.pipeline-state/` -- my checkout was never mutated. This is a fix to EXISTING apply_review/4 behaviour (not a new module), so the 'pre-fix failure is code-under-test-did-not-exist' exception (mandatory mutant-isolation re-run) does not apply -- the fail-then-pass proof itself, independently reproduced above with a real discriminating assertion failure (200 vs 409), is sufficient here.
